title: Job description draft
brief: Draft a job description for a mid-level claims adjuster from a hiring manager's rough notes.
context: The role is a mid-level claims adjuster. The hiring manager's rough notes are supplied as input and include the salary band. Most candidates will read the posting on a phone. The notes mix genuine requirements with nice-to-haves.
constraints: Real requirements only, no wish list
output_format: Role | What you'll do (5 bullets) | Required | Helpful | Salary & location, with scannable subheadings.
role_and_audience: External candidates browsing on a phone
reference_prompt:
Write a job description for a mid-level claims adjuster from the hiring manager's notes below.

Audience: external candidates, most of them reading on a phone.

Requirements:
- Inclusive, bias-free language. No "rockstar", no "young and dynamic", no gendered terms.
- Requirements section lists only what is genuinely required. Move everything else to "helpful".
- State the salary band exactly as given in the notes.
- Under 400 words, with scannable subheadings.

Output format: Role | What you'll do (5 bullets) | Required | Helpful | Salary & location.

Notes: {{notes}}
